title: An object should not extend any type of Throwable.
summary: Throwables are stateful and should be instantiated only when needed for when a specific error occurs. An object, being a singleton, that extends any type of Throwable consequently introduces a global singleton exception whose instance may be inadvertently reused from multiple places, thus introducing shared mutable state. It is in the exceptions rule set. detekt runs it by default since 2.0.0. It needs type resolution.
